TestInternodeSSL::test_putget_with_inter.description: 4-node cluster (1 DC, 2 racks x 2 nodes, GossipingPropertyFileSnitch) with server_encryption_options internode_encryption='all' and internode_compression='all'; creates NTS RF=2 keyspace and runs putget (100-cell batch at QUORUM, flush, overwrite, read back and validate).
